call.title: CRM hygiene — 2026-11-13
call.content:
CRM hygiene — 2026-11-13
5 fixes: 1 duplicate, 2 missing, 2 stale

## Duplicates
- Ana Ruiz, Acme Ltd — two records (uid c12: ana@acme.example; uid c41: ana.ruiz@acme.example). Fix: ask which email is current, then merge into one.

## Missing
- Yew — no contact email and no owner on the pipeline line. Fix: add both or park the deal.
- Cal (Cedar Ltd) — contact record has no phone. Fix: add from the last signature block.

## Stale
| Account | Stage | Last touch | Days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cedar Ltd | Proposal sent | 2026-10-01 | 43 |
| Yew | Discovery | 2026-09-28 | 46 |

## Fix list
1. c12 / c41 — merge Ana Ruiz once the current email is confirmed.
2. Pipeline, Yew — add contact and owner.
3. c7 (Cal) — add phone.
4. Pipeline, Cedar Ltd — touch or move to Stalled.
5. Pipeline, Yew — touch or close.

## Checked
- 58 contacts listed; "Pipeline" read (4 lines). Nothing was changed.

script.say:
5 fixes: one duplicate Ana Ruiz record, two missing fields, Cedar and Yew stale (43 and 46 days).
